name: courtlistener-mcp
description: Access millions of legal opinions, court cases, judges, and federal regulations through CourtListener API v4 and eCFR
long_description: The CourtListener MCP Server provides comprehensive access to legal case data, court opinions, and federal regulations through the extensive CourtListener and eCFR databases. Features include searching opinions/dockets/audio, retrieving specific cases, judge information, financial disclosures, citation parsing, and federal regulation lookup.
